title: UltraKeep
description: Limited-Time Keep inventory for new players

<details>
<summary>Text Transcrip</summary>

The Ultra Keep plugin
Allows you to give new players a 'keep inventory' grace period, preventing them from dying quickly, losing everything, and leaving the server.

You can configure the messages, the duration, and even a bossbar

----------------------------------------

COMMANDS
- /ultrakeep add <player> <minutes>
- /ultrakeep set <player> <minutes>
- /ultrakeep remove <player>
- /ultrakeep info <player>
- /ultrakeep reload

For any questions, you can ask on our Discord server.
https://discord.gg/ZdhHrURycn
</details>
